principle: Heuristics derive context from local records; they do not silently widen locality or permissions.

locality_match.rule: prefer the narrowest scope compatible with the requested context

presence.input: recent local events + active node state
presence.rule: presence requires recent evidence; absence is not inferred from silence alone

provenance.rule: prefer direct local observations over derived or remote claims

gates.locality: candidate.locality_scope must be allowed by the requesting context
gates.sensitivity: candidate.sensitivity must be allowed before scoring
gates.retention: expired records are excluded from context projections
gates.export: remote output requires an explicit export decision

ranking.normalization: all component scores are normalized to [0,1]

failure_policy.missing_data: return unknown rather than inventing a value
failure_policy.conflicting_sources: retain both observations and lower confidence in the derived context
failure_policy.permission_denied: omit the record from the projection rather than redacting its meaning into a new fact
